customer_question: Unbelievable. You charged our card TWICE for November, two identical $49 charges on the same day. I wrote about this on Monday and nobody has answered. Get a billing person on this today. I want to talk to a manager, not another bot.
resolution: Escalated to the billing queue at high priority: duplicate charge, repeated contact and an explicit request for a manager. Support apologised and did not promise a refund or any timeline beyond the 24-hour response time for Pro. The billing team verified two paid invoices of $49.00 on the same date and reversed the duplicate, and a billing team lead called the customer. The reversal appeared on the card statement within 5-7 business days.
